remarks: Experience the ultimate Westport lifestyle at this stunning residence nestled in the heart of Westport! This exquisite home seamlessly blends casual elegance with masterful design, providing the perfect setting for both indoor and outdoor living. As you step inside, be captivated by the soaring ceilings and the effortless flow of the living spaces. The gourmet eat-in kitchen, boasting a large island, pantry, and high-end appliances, effortlessly connects to the bluestone patio and the large family room. The dining room comfortably seats 8, perfect for hosting memorable gatherings. The main level also offers a well-appointed study, ideal for working from home, and a gym that can also serve as a 5th bedroom if needed. Upstairs, the serene primary suite awaits with a relaxing sitting area, 2 walk-in closets, and a spa-like bathroom. Three additional en suite bedrooms provide ample space for family or guests, while the versatile playroom with a bar and half bath offers flexible living options. Step outside to your own private oasis, complete with a breathtaking gunite saltwater pool and spa, accompanied by a pool house featuring a bar, TV, bathroom, laundry, and outdoor shower - everything you need for endless enjoyment. Additionally, a greenhouse awaits to indulge your gardening passion. Don't miss the opportunity to experience the Westport lifestyle at its finest. This residence is a true gem, offering an unrivaled combination of luxury, comfort, and leisure.
